segments.en: Wait a minute.
segments.zh: 等一下。

segments.en: What's that?
segments.zh: 那是什么？

segments.en: Donuts?
segments.zh: 甜甜圈？

segments.en: Are they organic donuts, Kelly?
segments.zh: 它们是有机甜甜圈吗，凯利？

segments.en: But I like donuts.
segments.zh: 可我喜欢甜甜圈。

segments.en: Alright, we're back.
segments.zh: 好了，我们回来了。

segments.en: So talking about healthy food and healthy eating, how healthy do you eat, Katherine?
segments.zh: 那么谈到健康食品和健康饮食，你吃得有多健康，凯瑟琳？

segments.en: I think I eat pretty decently.
segments.zh: 我觉得我吃得很不错。

segments.en: I try to eat a balanced diet.
segments.zh: 我试着吃均衡的饮食。

segments.en: Like I said earlier, I think a balanced diet is a key to a healthy lifestyle.
segments.zh: 就像我之前说的，我认为均衡的饮食是健康生活方式的关键。

segments.en: I don't really eat fast food.
segments.zh: 我真的不吃快餐。

segments.en: I try not to eat too much meat or too much sugar.
segments.zh: 我尽量不要吃太多肉或过多的糖。

segments.en: What about organic stuff?
segments.zh: 有机物呢？

segments.en: Are you a big fan of organic vegetables, organic meats?
segments.zh: 您是有机蔬菜、有机肉类的忠实粉丝吗？

segments.en: I am.
segments.zh: 我是。

segments.en: And this comes from a part of the dialogue we didn't cover.
segments.zh: 这来自我们没有涵盖的对话的一部分。

segments.en: One of the characters says that vegetables are the green option.
segments.zh: 其中一位人物说蔬菜是绿色的选择。

segments.en: So trying to eat organic food and think about green is a part of thinking about the environment.
segments.zh: 因此，尝试吃有机食品并考虑绿色是思考环境的一部分。

segments.en: And so I think eating organic vegetables is an important part of caring about the environment because the more chemicals, the more pesticides we put into the world, the more harmful it is for the earth, for animals and for ourselves.
segments.zh: 所以我认为吃有机蔬菜是关心环境的重要组成部分，因为化学物质越多，我们投入世界的杀虫剂就越多，对地球、动物和我们自己的危害就越大。

segments.en: Yeah, that's absolutely true.
segments.zh: 是的，这绝对是真的。

segments.en: And it has become a more popular aspect around America and Europe, people choosing to go with organic vegetables, for example, eggs that were grown on an organic farm.
segments.zh: 它已成为美国和欧洲更受欢迎的方面，人们选择使用有机蔬菜，例如在有机农场种植的鸡蛋。

segments.en: And so it is the healthier option and obviously the green option as we saw in the dialogue.
segments.zh: 因此，它是更健康的选择，显然是我们在对话中看到的绿色选项。

segments.en: Okay, so a very interesting topic.
segments.zh: 好吧，这是一个非常有趣的话题。

segments.en: We want to know what your opinion is on it.
segments.zh: 我们想知道您对此有何看法。

segments.en: Why don't you come to our website EnglishPod.com and tell us if you are a fan of the light or green organic lifestyle or maybe you just really don't really care.
segments.zh: 您为什么不来我们的网站 englishpod.com 告诉我们您是光明或绿色有机生活方式的粉丝，还是您真的不在乎。

segments.en: Maybe you love junk food.
segments.zh: 也许你喜欢垃圾食品。

segments.en: Let us know EnglishPod.com.
segments.zh: 让我们知道 Englishpod.com。

segments.en: All right, we'll see you guys there.
segments.zh: 好，到时候在那里见。

segments.en: Bye.
segments.zh: 再见。

segments.en: Bye.
segments.zh: 再见。
